items.title: U.S. CFTC chief puts staff on notice to create crypto regulations if Clarity Act fails
CFTC Chair Readies Crypto Rules If Congress Fails to Pass Clarity Act
items.summary: The CFTC chair said staff is already exploring a crypto market structure framework and could move quickly to propose rules if Congress fails to act.
